(Your Life Deck may include non-Personality cards that are "Heroes only.")

Raise or lower a player's anger 2. You may Rejuvenate a card that is Alignment-restricted from your discard pile.

HIT: If you have changed levels this combat, search your discard pile for a card that is Alignment-restricted and place it into your hand.
